column2: Austria has recognized Prussian hegemony. Hanover, Hesse-Kassel, Nassau and Frankfurt are annexed to Prussia and become Prussian core territory. Prussia also establishes core claims in Schleswig and Holstein, incorporating the territory administered by Austria and the two duchies. The remaining German minor states become Prussian satellites. Austria remains independent.
Prussian victory has reshaped Germany. Our country ends its ties with its previous overlord and becomes a Prussian satellite, allied with Prussia.
